notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We are pleased to announce that the first hotfix is now live!

List of changes:

 We fixed empty tips from the boss
 Cleaning cart content should now move with the cart
 Few translation fixes
 Double doors are now fixed
 Few achievement improvements
 New sounds added


Please enjoy!

notes.title: Devlog #11 - Release date annoucement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

08.08.2024

Yes, release of Before Exit on PC is less than month away. We basically completed whole gameplay loop and now we are focusing on polishing and fixing issues that we have found. We have playtested the game and even in current state it was pretty playable, so we expect that release should go expected to proceed smoothly…

… as always.

We are not experienced studio, but we already went trough some game releases. Some of them was directly produced by us, in some we were part of a team. It’s hard to predict what will exactly happen after such crucial day in a game development cycle. Will there be game breaking bug that we have to patch right after? Or some players will experience crashes that we never encounter? Or there will be silence and no one buys our game? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055880/e6195bcd00ebac97d9cc4cd1fe50b66363244857.png

No matter what, we will have our latest answer in less than a month. We hope you all hop on this train and help us make Before Exit the best possible experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055880/d8ec7ceea35d19c98d731fcf81677286ace8f05e.jpg

Again, we warmly invite you to visit our Discord and add the game to your wish list!
